filesystem_isolation.note: sandbox-exec deny-read backstop; native toolsets are additionally restricted to [todo] in the generated Hermes config so the scoped seeder MCP tools are the only research path

release_boundary.note: Cross-branch scientific evidence becomes shareable only when the controller releases it AT this level boundary (research-release). Infrastructure corrections distribute immediately after controller review (research-review).

agenda.shelve: budget exhaustion or repeated sessions with no new activity shelve an investigation; shelved items stay durable and resumable

_comment: DISABLED EXAMPLE for the autonomous research agenda (Hermes backend by default; claude_code works identically). The agenda runs investigations that span sessions, with preserved checkpoints, finite budgets, and automatic shelving of unproductive lines. Agenda eligibility is a pure storage read — idle scheduling never costs model calls. Branch-private scientific results never cross branches before an explicit release at the level boundary; infrastructure corrections distribute only after controller review and physically cannot carry scientific fields. Research sessions never modify or inject findings into existing campaigns; the RSI attempt side consumes findings ONLY through the nonblocking research-check. All data lives under the research root (default <run-root>/autoresearch-seeder-research), which is machine-local and never committed.
